bio: This friendly establishment is named after an ancient Burgundy wine festival, which is far from a coincidence. It is even possible to buy a bottle to take home from the sensibly priced wine bin. The culinary score errs towards the traditional, albeit with a more contemporary lineup of suggestions. Examples include tender juicy veal garnished with a poultry sauce enriched in Comté cheese and a gratin of sliced potatoes and onions. The lunchtime menu embodies the big-hearted mindset of this culinary landmark of Tournai....
